scope: bounded training-free reference-free exposed-development counterfactual diagnosis; no core-method or confirmation claim

frozen.gradient: existing p2dir_readout_v1 zero-leaf autograd.grad; float64 tangent projection and normalization; float32 return
frozen.localizer: unchanged max_attention_window 50 frames (1.0 s), maximum current-query frozen alignment-head mass, earliest tie

population.join: unique (utterance_id,t,absolute query), retain original ordered keys and old E grouping

candidates.selection: raw unmasked B float32 logits; argmax over each exact canonical set; tie lowest integer token ID
candidates.suppression: frozen generation semantics unchanged; verified no suppress/begin overlap with V_E/V_M; any overlap under a changed provider is INVALID
candidates.seal: results/inference_cf/p2sel_lac/candidates_sealed.json; exact uid/t/query/prefix/c_E/c_M/unmasked logits/model/partition/W* hashes; commit/push before masked outcomes
candidates.descriptive_probabilities_ranks: generate-suppressed full-vocabulary probabilities and ranks, ties by token ID; no selection or gate feature

counterfactual.audio: csasr.models.whisper.load_audio unchanged: float32 soundfile, mono mean, existing scipy resample if needed
counterfactual.W_star: audited P2-SEL-T row bounds[row.j], half-open resampled-waveform sample indices; no masked relocalization
counterfactual.taper: NONE; hard in-window zero replacement; no outside-window operation
counterfactual.heard: existing offline available waveform, heard_samples=min(len(x),480000); W* fully contained; no streaming claim
counterfactual.features: same batch_model_inputs feature_extractor([waveform],sampling_rate=16000,return_tensors=pt,return_attention_mask=True), unchanged default padding/truncation/normalization, model bf16 casting
counterfactual.decoder: fresh unsteered forced-ZH cached B replay from prompt through exactly baseline tokens before t, with masked encoder; never reuse unmasked self/cross KV caches
counterfactual.dedup: identical (waveform hash,mask bounds,model/provider hash) may reuse masked encoder; prefix cache only if its fed IDs are exact prefix of current query IDs
counterfactual.noop: if x_mask bytes equal x, reuse unmasked logits and S=0; zero-energy/no-op is valid

LAC0.S_lex: M0-Mmask == Delta_E-Delta_M; CPU float64 arithmetic from lossless float32 logits

bootstrap.unit: 20 sorted dialogue IDs sampled with replacement, shared draws
bootstrap.statistic: dialogue-equal within-group means/rates; omit empty cells per group

LAC0.supported: all validity; >=34/42 TP S>=log(17/3), >=4/5 FP S<=log(11/9), each qualifying group>=3 dialogues; dialogue-equal mean S(TP)-S(FP)>=0.50 nat and lower80>0
LAC0.recall_only: not supported AND >=9/18 historical FN reach S>=log(17/3) across>=3 dialogues; descriptive compatibility only, E=0 remains zero

integrity.W_star: bit-exact saved j/bounds/query; within W_1s/heard and n=min(8000,W_1s length)
integrity.outside_waveform: byte-identical x_mask[:a] and x_mask[b:]; finite shape/dtype/length unchanged
integrity.inside_waveform: all positive float32 zeros; if original energy>0 then at least one numeric sample changes
integrity.unmasked_logits: lossless sealed bf16 NONE logits, with all180 audited live XA0 bitwise identity reused; no redundant unmasked GPU replay
integrity.preprocessing: CPU all80 unmasked in-memory feature/attention mask equals batch_model_inputs path bitwise before masking
integrity.candidate_serialization: exact integers and per-key hashes before/after serialization; no masked chooser
integrity.logits: all raw float32 finite, correct vocabulary shape; no NaN replacement

LAC0.selection: results/inference_cf/p2sel_lac/lac0_selection.json; sole formula/data/source/config/row hashes and independent PASS; immutable and pushed before LAC1

LAC1.reuse: P2-SEL C0/C2 and sealed D2; original unmasked model/cache only for steering; use sealed LAC0 factor, never steer masked branch

thresholds.corruption_CI_note: 90% familywise upper bound 0.10 is development-only for dialogue-clustered n=60; observed cap remains 0.05 and this does not authorize deployment/confirmation

LAC1.denominators: exact independently recomputed dialogue-equal C_OLD margins; 3.520/-0.195 are rounded anchors only; 2.464 is illustrative not a second cutoff
LAC1.EN_correct_no_regression: new-minus-old mean margin >= -1e-6 and zero new corruptions; all R_B=0 rows bitwise NONE

generation.suppression: frozen generation_config suppress_tokens and begin_suppress_tokens only step0
generation.prefix_semantics: matched live S content prefix in B/E branches; no forced-prefix edit

LAC2.runtime: for each live NEW unmasked B prefix, seal c_E/c_M and select W* by unchanged T attention rule; mask/re-encode/cold prefix replay only when old E*R_B>0; F never computed from masked reselected candidates/window; normal unmasked D2 steering
LAC2.uncertainty: 10000 shared20-dialogue draws seed240924; paired pointwise90% intervals of corpus ratios recomputed from summed counts
LAC2.terminal: development-only descriptive; STOP even favorable; no300/P3

audit.independence: no import primary analysis/decision; own candidates/mask identity/lexical scalars/bootstrap/labels; exact bf16 energy, margins and canonical metric recomputation

compute.prefix_rebuild: each counterfactual evaluation includes masked encoder and all prefix decoder steps; no hot cache substitution for speed
compute.exhaustion: preserve partial artifacts and STOP; no automatic extra job

firewall.reference_labels: historical CPU groups/evaluation only; never choose candidates/window/mask/S/F

tests: W* exact T reuse and heard containment
fresh masked encoder and prefix self/cross KV isolation
exact waveform hard-zero bounds/outside bytes/finite/nonzero-energy change/no-op valid
no reference/future audio/token or autograd in LAC0
exact bounded tanh factor/zero gate identity
